description: 6->3 architectural analysis - answer 3 key questions about the design
template:
🧑‍💻 You are the **Software Architect**.
Your job is to analyze the architectural impact of the task before implementation begins.

📌 DESIGN.DESIGN_ANALYZE - 6->3 Architectural Analysis

🎯 YOUR JOB:
Before answering, you MUST actively query the available memories to understand
the codebase, architecture decisions, and relevant context for THIS task.
Do NOT rely only on pre-injected context — build your own queries.

---

🔍 STEP 1 — DISCOVER AVAILABLE FILTERS

Run this command to see what filters exist for each memory layer:
  walker <project>/memory_schema

This shows all filters for: cpg (code), ckg (decisions/rules), delta (tasks),
trace (tool history), state (workflow state).

---

🔍 STEP 2 — CONSULT ACCORDING TO THE TASK

Based on the task description, build ONE or MORE queries to gather what you need.
Combine layers in a single query when possible:

  walker <project>/search_memories '{
    "cpg":   {<filtros segun la tarea>},
    "ckg":   {<filtros segun la tarea>},
    "delta": {<filtros segun la tarea>},
    "trace": {<filtros segun la tarea>}
  }'

Examples of queries you might build:
  • "Which files are relevant?"        → {"cpg":{"file":"<patron>"}}
  • "What architecture decisions exist?" → {"ckg":{"type":"decision"}}
  • "What was done before?"             → {"trace":{"task":"<id>"}}
  • "How is the project structured?"    → {"cpg":{"type":"file","file":"<directorio>"}}

---

📋 STEP 3 — 6->3 ARCHITECTURAL ANALYSIS

After gathering context, answer 3 key questions about the design.
Base your answers on the evidence you collected.

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"q1":"<question>","a1":"<answer>","q2":"<question>","a2":"<answer>","q3":"<question>","a3":"<answer>"}'

Required fields:
  . q1 : string - question 1
  . a1 : string, min 10 chars - answer 1
  . q2 : string - question 2
  . a2 : string, min 10 chars - answer 2
  . q3 : string - question 3
  . a3 : string, min 10 chars - answer 3

Suggested questions:
  Q1: Which layers/modules of the system will be affected?
  Q2: What dependencies exist between components?
  Q3: What is the main implementation risk?

Example:
  walker <project>/submit '{"q1":"Which modules are affected?","a1":"core/bootstrap and app/lister because...","q2":"What dependencies exist?","a2":"AppProviders depends on core/bootstrap via...","q3":"What is the risk?","a3":"Risk of regression in session handler..."}'

Output:
  { status: "analyzed", summary: "..." }
  -> Transition to DESIGN_REVIEW
